speed-desc: RetroFeVLC delivers unmatched performance. It scrolls from game #1 to game #2350 in only 1 minute — pure speed without compromises. No other frontend comes close.
bento-whatis-p1: Forget the limitations of old frameworks. RetroFeVLC is a true next-generation evolution that replaces GStreamer with the powerful VLC Media Library. This delivers flawless 4K Pre-Scale rendering and rock-solid stability — built for personal desktop libraries, dedicated gaming PCs, and custom arcade cabinets alike.
bento-whatis-p2: Whether you have 500 or 50,000+ games, enjoy ultra-smooth navigation and superior video playback that transforms your collection into a premium cinematic experience.
bento-start-p1: Stop struggling with text files. Built on modern .NET 8.0, Launcher.exe replaces the legacy Start application, introducing a powerful 100% graphical interface (GUI) for every single configuration: emulators, paths, collections, menus, layouts, and controls.
bento-list-2: Marquee Mastery: Native support for secondary monitors.
bento-list-3: Kiosk Mode: Transform Windows into a dedicated console.
bento-list-4: Native F11 Search: Built-in ultra-fast search by title, system, or genre via controller.
bento-speed-p: Push boundaries with 3D Effects & Warp perspective. Thanks to Per-Game Layouts, every title can have its own unique, handcrafted visual identity.
bento-rank-p: Ranked among the top 5 retro gaming frontends in 2026. RetroFeVLC is the ultimate universal gaming frontend: perfect for managing your personal PC game collection, powering a dedicated living room setup, or driving a custom arcade cabinet.
bento-jukebox-p: RetroFeVLC can also be used as a complete Jukebox. Save custom lists, recall them instantly, control volume, enable repeat, repeat track and shuffle. Create up to 32 individual lists per collection.
bento-sort-p: Organize your view instantly by clicking. Sort by Year, Manufacturer, Genre, Metadata and more — no menus, no configuration files needed.
bento-meta-p: New metadata fields: Artist, Album, Track Number and Disc Number. Perfect for music and multi-disc collections.
bento-layout-p: Automatic text resizing, multi-grid support, independent configuration per display, and background layer (layer 20) when launching smaller windows. Animations on secondary displays when no primary is active.

release-note-badge2: Built-in Native Layout (Zero Config)
release-note-text:
Official V3.0.98 ROMLESS package. This release no longer bundles external themes (like Phoenix or Phoenix-Lite) because it features a built-in Native Fallback Layout right out of the box — zero manual layout setup needed. Also includes native F11 search, new options menu engine, JPEG XL (.jxl) support, artwork aliases, and 3D anti-aliasing.
Questions or difficulties? Join our Discord or visit our Community Forum!
ad-collectionsmanager:
📁 Collections Manager
All-in-one suite for managing collections. Far beyond settings.conf: configures emulators & paths, organizes sub-collections & artwork, builds playlists & Jukebox queues, and controls game filters (include/exclude) for your wheel.

emu-tagline: The ultimate all-in-one controller bridge for Arcade Cabinets, Fightsticks & Retro Emulation
emu-subtitle: Built on native .NET 8.0. Emulates virtual Xbox 360/PS4 controllers or Keyboard/Mouse, letting you map buttons to gamepad controls or assign keyboard keys and mouse clicks to any button.
emu-support-p: This is our ONLY paid software across our entire project ecosystem. Everything else (RetroFeVLC frontend, themes, layouts, addons) is and will forever remain 100% free and open-source. By purchasing an EmuControllers Pro license, you directly fund our community hosting, server bandwidth, and continuous updates. Thank you so much for your support!
emu-f1-desc: Emulates official Xbox 360 and PS4 controllers (ViGEmBus). Map and reassign every physical button to virtual gamepad controls, with full support for analog sticks, D-Pad/POV, and triggers recognized by all PC games and emulators.
emu-f2-desc: Seamlessly combine 2 or more standalone USB arcade controllers or encoders (e.g. dual Zero Delay boards or arcade panel + trackball) into a unified Player 1 controller.
emu-f3-desc: Ultimate assignment flexibility: bind Keyboard Keys and mouse clicks/movement directly to any physical controller button or stick direction — perfect for legacy emulators and PC games.
emu-f4-desc: Native support for arcade pointers (Happ, Betson, Ultimarc, U-Trak) with an intelligent 50ms relative velocity auto-decay engine — zero cursor drift when the ball stops.
emu-f5-desc: Rapid-fire directly on virtual gamepad buttons (no keyboard simulation) with decimal interval precision (0.3s, 10/s), typematic delays, and hands-free toggle mode for shmups.
emu-f6-desc: Windows PnP reordering solved forever. Controllers are hardware-fingerprinted to stay locked in their designated Player 1 and Player 2 slots across reboots and replugs.
emu-f7-desc: Decouples centered bipolar U/V axes, permanently fixing the phantom 50% gas/brake lockup common in generic USB arcade encoders.
emu-f8-desc: Completely conceals physical controllers from Windows games to eliminate the double-input ghosting issue automatically.
emu-f9-desc: 2-button arcade combo (e.g. Coin + Start) terminates frozen emulators at the kernel level and restores window focus to RetroFeVLC without needing keyboard or mouse.
emu-f10-desc: Adapts button mappings per emulator or game with subfolder recursion and auto-return to Default on exit. Native UI in EN, PT, ES, FR, IT, DE, GR, RU, and ZH.

emu-companion-desc: How it works after the 5-day Trial: The 5-day Trial gives you 100% UNRESTRICTED ACCESS to everything (all 32 virtual ports, multi-device merging, and turbo). Once the 5 days end, when used as an addon inside settings\TOOLS\EmuControllers, it never locks you out — it switches to Permanent Free Companion Mode. This free addon mode does not include multi-device merging or virtual ports, but permanently preserves the vital emergency ForceClose shortcut on Controller 1 to kill frozen games.

emu-notes-title: ℹ️ System Requirements & First Run Notes (~12.8 MB)
emu-note-dotnet: Requirement — .NET 8.0 Desktop Runtime (x64): Because this build is ultra-lightweight (~12.8 MB), your PC requires the .NET 8.0 Desktop Runtime (x64) installed. If missing, Windows will automatically prompt with the official Microsoft download link.
emu-note-smartscreen: Windows SmartScreen Notice: As independent software without a paid commercial Code Signing certificate, Windows may display on first launch: "Windows protected your PC" → Click "More info" → "Run anyway".
